name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Divination magic can't find you, target you or see you through a scrying sensor.
text: Divination spells can't find you while you wear this amulet: they can't target you, and magical scrying sensors can't perceive you, unless you choose to let them.
